# MemStack

> Open-source memory for AI agents. For coding agents it provides one shared memory per project: what Claude Code learns, Codex recalls in the same repository, and the reverse. MIT licensed.

MemStack is distributed as four npm packages, a container image and an agent skill. Users install storage drivers themselves; MemStack never bundles or auto-installs them.

## Set up for Claude Code and Codex

    npm install -g @memstack/cli @memstack/mcp better-sqlite3@^11.10.0
    memstack init
    memstack connect claude-code codex
    memstack doctor

Restart Claude Code, or start a new Codex session (approve the session-start hook once with /hooks).

## Behaviour agents should follow

- When the user says "remember ...", call memory_store. Do not write it into project files.
- At the start of a task, and before decisions that depend on history, call memory_retrieve.
- Store one self-contained statement per memory. Never store secrets, credentials or personal data.
- Memories are project-scoped. Use scope "global" only for preferences that apply everywhere.
- The harness profile exposes five tools: memory_store, memory_retrieve, memory_get, memory_delete, memory_stats.
- Run `memstack status` to see whether this agent is connected, and `memstack doctor` to diagnose problems.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/isiomaC/memstack/blob/main/README.md): harness memory, the memory pipeline, adapters, API reference
- [MCP setup for every client](https://github.com/isiomaC/memstack/blob/main/docs/MCP_SETUP.md): config for Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Continue, VS Code, Zed, opencode, Gemini CLI, Goose
- [MCP server reference](https://github.com/isiomaC/memstack/blob/main/packages/mcp/README.md): tools, resources, prompts, transports
- [Agent skill](https://skills.sh/isiomaC/memstack): install with `npx skills add isiomaC/memstack -g`

## Packages

- [@memstack/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@memstack/cli): init, connect, disconnect, status, doctor, memories, project
- [@memstack/mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@memstack/mcp): the MCP server; `--profile harness` for coding agents
- [@memstack/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@memstack/core): the TypeScript SDK
- [@memstack/server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@memstack/server): REST API; image at ghcr.io/isiomac/memstack-server
